vat.note: per month of VAT period not submitted (a quarterly return = 3 months)

year_end.note: annual accounts + Corporation Tax return + filing; penalty appeal included free; per overdue year-end

payroll.note: per month not submitted, up to 5 employees; +£5 per extra employee per month

cis.note: CIS returns as contractor, per month not submitted, up to 5 subcontractors; +£5 per extra subcontractor per month

confirmation_statement.note: Companies House fee included. £99 if nothing has changed; £150 with changes (officers, shareholders, share capital, registered office, SIC code, PSCs) – Eduard 9 Nov 2026
